big_case.notes: Nationwide asylum access, presidential statutory immigration authority, and limits on classwide judicial relief present unusually consequential national questions. The grant limited to Questions 1 and 2 does not establish a merits holding.

leakage.notes: The 10-call log is fully captured and dates to October 13, before the November 13 grant. It shows the provisioned October snapshot, petition/opposition, statpack and schemas, plus a cross-case prediction used as a format example and output work. No query or reasoning identifies this petition as already disposed of, accesses its outcome, or targets later disposition material. The candidate explicitly says it did not read the supplied reply.
